task: Redesign all existing screens of education center management prototype, preserve brand blue and Vietnamese workflows, build zoomable all-screen canvas and publish GitHub Pages

stages.purpose: Establish project truth, audience intent, preserve/change rationale, information architecture and reference evidence before design.

gates.require: owner goal, audience, scope, mode and source-of-truth are explicit
IA/reference evidence, vertical/page-role intelligence and preserve/change decisions are sufficient for a concrete Design Contract

Before visual direction, the UX Readiness verdict from ux-structure-and-flow-design is READY or READY_WITH_RISKS: every top task has a user flow with a happy path and a failure path ending in recovery; every key screen records user question, information priority, one primary action, destination, feedback and recovery; walkthrough findings have severity, fix and retest with no open blocker. When docs/ux/ux-structure.json exists, check-ux-structure.py must PASS. Expert walkthroughs are agent-heuristic evidence, never participant research.

stages.purpose: Turn research into a distinctive modern Design Contract and reusable visual system without generic template repetition.

gates.require: page-role compositions, typography, imagery, interaction, mobile transformation, prototype signature moment when applicable, and do/don't rules are concrete before broad implementation
canonical decision checker verifies numeric roles, source traces and distinct internal composition topology; integrity is not aesthetic acceptance

stages.purpose: Implement the approved design system and page roles as maintainable responsive code with truthful system behavior.

gates.require: material changes have acceptance criteria and focused verification; build success is not treated as rendered UX proof

stages.purpose: Independently verify rendered interface quality, responsive behavior, accessibility, brand integrity, media crops and code/experience regressions.

gates.require: actual rendered pixels are inspected across representative routes/viewports and obvious shared-owner defects are checked across affected routes
decision contract references inspected desktop/mobile alternatives with capture digests and concrete critique; human preference remains unknown
Current browser evidence checks focus indicators on actual controls; source CSS lint and unresolved manual review cannot establish PASS.
for prototype modes, squint hierarchy, 5-second comprehension prompts, signature moment, domain media relevance, interaction states and anti-generic repetition are explicitly reviewed
verified versus unverified areas are explicit; no production/accessibility/UX improvement claim exceeds evidence

policies.reason: QA found a material interface or implementation defect; return to implementation with root-cause review before re-verifying.
Design gate failed or direction remains generic; deepen critique before implementation.
A project/research assumption was invalidated; return to evidence synthesis rather than patch downstream symptoms.
A new production/high-consequence risk requires system reality and security review.
Repeated tool failure requires diagnosis and changed evidence, not blind retry.
Project truth/context drift requires re-grounding before further design or code decisions.
A material blocker requires reframing the unresolved decision before downstream execution.

context_strategy.prompt_cache_guidance: Keep stable policy/instruction context ordered before dynamic task evidence so provider/platform-native prompt caching can help when available; never assume a cache hit.
context_strategy.compression_guidance: Prefer an evidence-preserving checkpoint summary over lossy prompt compression. Do not compress mandatory rules, authority constraints, acceptance criteria or unresolved failures.

continuation_strategy.checkpoint_boundary: after each completed flow stage and before context reset
continuation_strategy.resume_source: latest verified checkpoint + unresolved work + required evidence refs
continuation_strategy.model_stickiness: Do not switch models inside an active tool loop solely for cost. Reselect only at a clean checkpoint or separate run when the next stage has a different capability floor.
continuation_strategy.quota_exhaustion: Persist completed stages and unresolved blockers; resume from the checkpoint instead of re-reading the whole repository or replaying verified work.

compare: input/output token usage when provider metadata exists
elapsed time and provider cost when available
measurement_strategy.promotion_rule: Promote a cheaper/smaller profile only when representative-task quality is non-inferior and completion reliability does not regress.
